messages.subject: fixed difference... subscript out of bounds
parts:
Hello everyone, 

for a while now (and with different DArT sata sets) I've been trying to get genetic distance measures. 
Both gl.fixed.diff and gl.dist.pop (with method set to "pcfixed") I get the same error message all the time:

Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, popi, popj, value = sum(fixed, na.rm = TRUE)) : 
  subscript out of bounds


I cannot find anything about this error message and was wondering whether other people have managed to use those functions?
Maybe my data isn't adequate or I'm not inputting the code properly. If you have an idea why this might not work please let me know :-)

d <- gl.dist.pop(gl1, method ="pcfixed", diag = TRUE)


d <- gl.fixed.diff(gl1, tloc= 0, test= TRUE, delta = 0.02, rm.global.monomorphs = TRUE, reps = 1000, v=1)


I appreciate the support!
Kind regards, 
Katrin

messages.subject: Re: fixed difference... subscript out of bounds

Hi Katrin,

Just to be sure we are on the same page (using the same scripts), can you try running the following. If that fails, then we are using different versions of the scripts, or it is something about your data (pops well defined?), because they work for me.

Run it one line at a time.

Cheers.

# Define a useful test population 
  gl <- testset.gl
  levels(pop(gl))<-c(rep("Coast",5),rep("Cooper",3),rep("Coast",5),
  rep("MDB",8),rep("Coast",7),"Em.subglobosa","Em.victoriae")
  popNames(gl)
 
# Test gl.dist.pop
  gl.dist.pop(gl,method="pcfixed")
  gl.dist.pop(gl,method ="pcfixed", diag = TRUE)
 
# Test gl.fixed.diff
  gl.fixed.diff(gl)
  gl.fixed.diff(gl, tloc= 0, test= TRUE, delta = 0.02, rm.global.monomorphs = TRUE, reps = 1000, v=1)
